<module id="calendar">
    <description>Perpetual calendar with continuous seconds, minutes, and hours.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active-high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
        <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
        <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic for Seconds
        reg [5:0] Secs_reg;
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                Secs_reg <= 6'd0;
            end else if (Secs_reg == 6'd59) begin
                Secs_reg <= 6'd0;
            end else begin
                Secs_reg <= Secs_reg + 6'd1;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for Minutes
        reg [5:0] Mins_reg;
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                Mins_reg <= 6'd0;
            end else if (Mins_reg == 6'd59 && Secs_reg == 6'd59) begin
                Mins_reg <= 6'd0;
            end else if (Secs_reg == 6'd59) begin
                Mins_reg <= Mins_reg + 6'd1;
            end else begin
                Mins_reg <= Mins_reg;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for Hours
        reg [5:0] Hours_reg;
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                Hours_reg <= 6'd0;
            end else if (Hours_reg == 6'd23 && Mins_reg == 6'd59 && Secs_reg == 6'd59) begin
                Hours_reg <= 6'd0;
            end else if (Mins_reg == 6'd59 && Secs_reg == 6'd59) begin
                Hours_reg <= Hours_reg + 6'd1;
            end else begin
                Hours_reg <= Hours_reg;
            end
        end
        
        // Assign outputs
        assign Secs = Secs_reg;
        assign Mins = Mins_reg;
        assign Hours = Hours_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
